lines.en: I head over to the bar to meet up with Imani and others and find myself spending the entire night focusing on her- though, not intentionally.
lines.zh: 我去酒吧和 Imani 她们碰面，结果整晚都在注意她——虽然不是故意的。

lines.en: You see, Imani was feeling particularly bored today and decided to come here a solid hour before the rest of us. Which means that she was already pretty drunk by the time we arrived.
lines.zh: 你看，Imani 今天特别无聊，决定比我们早整整一个小时到。也就是说我们到的时候她已经喝得挺醉了。

lines.en: And when Imani is drunk, Imani is...
lines.zh: 而 Imani 一醉，Imani 就……

lines.en: Well, take normal Imani and just multiply her by five.
lines.zh: 这么说吧，把平时的 Imani 乘以五。

lines.en: It doesn't happen all the time as she's normally pretty good at holding herself back. But when it {i}does{/i} happen, it's basically the only thing any of us can focus on.
lines.zh: 这也不是常有的事，她平时挺能克制的。但一旦{i}真{/i}发生了，基本上就成了我们所有人唯一能关注的事。
或者说……唯一{i}被允许{/i}关注的事。

lines.en: As you may have guessed, she talks my ear off and seemingly forgets that there are other people with us as well. Which is fine by me as it provides a great deal of attention-
lines.zh: 你可能猜到了，她一直在我耳边说个不停，好像忘了旁边还有别人。这对我来说倒也无所谓，因为能收获大量注意力——

lines.en: But is also annoying- as it provides a great deal of attention.
lines.zh: 但也很烦——因为能收获大量注意力。

lines.en: Eventually, Imani accepts that she has had enough and elects me as the person responsible for bringing her home.
lines.zh: 最后 Imani 承认自己喝够了，并指定我负责送她回家。

lines.en: As such, the two of us depart from the bar a bit earlier than Wakana and Rika and make our way out into the streets, barely managing to stay upright on account of one of us being dead weight.
lines.zh: 于是我们比 Wakana 和 Rika 早一点离开酒吧，走上街头，因为我们当中有一个完全是累赘，勉强才没倒下。

lines.en: Imani needs to completely rely on the support of my arm to even walk and stays latched onto it the whole way back to her apartment.
lines.zh: Imani 得完全靠我的胳膊撑着才能走路，一路到她的公寓都紧紧抓着不放。

lines.en: Thankfully, the walk isn't all that long...so I'm able to get her up the stairs and into bed without a hitch.
lines.zh: 幸好路不算远……我顺利把她扶上楼梯、弄到床上。

lines.en: As I turn around to leave, she thanks me and informs me that I can crash here as well if I want.
lines.zh: 我转身要走时，她道了谢，还说我想的话也可以在这儿睡。

lines.en: But seeing as her apartment is the size of my torso and her blood alcohol level is 300%%, I decide to just head back home instead...
lines.zh: 但看她那间公寓只有我躯干那么大，而她的血液酒精浓度大概有 300%%，我决定还是回家……
